purpose: Explicit, verified record-level alignment methods for paired comparison values. An empty methods list means no chart-ready paired series may be produced.

requirements.alignment: Every method must name the exact source table, alignment keys, value fields, units, and exclusions. Row-number pairing, interpolation, silent normalization, and ambiguous unit conversion are forbidden.
requirements.verification: A method is usable only when verified is true and verification_reference points to a committed scientific decision record.
requirements.conditions: The authoritative comparability decision must be comparable after conditions are evaluated. A conditionally_comparable or hard-status decision cannot produce paired values.
requirements.value_kind: Measured and computed values may be paired only when the comparability rule explicitly distinguishes them.
requirements.units: The method must use identical units or an explicitly documented conversion approved by the rule.
